caption: The drawing features a collection of decorative blue motifs and two outlined vessels on a beige or tan background. The motifs are generally symmetrical and appear to be floral or foliate in design, with repeated curved shapes and dots. Along the top edge, a horizontal vine-like pattern with small leaves and dots is depicted in dark blue. On the left side, there is a simple outline of a jar or vase with a short neck and a blue ornamental flourish near its shoulder. On the right side, there is an outline of a pitcher with a handle and a shorter neck, also featuring a blue flourish near the top. Between and around the vessels are several blue decorative elements: pairings and groupings of C-shaped arcs, braided ring shapes, and leaflike flourishes, some forming horizontal bands or framing ellipses, all rendered in various shades of blue with darker outlines and lighter blue fills. The background is a consistent tan wash, creating contrast with the blue designs.
title: Jug and Decoration
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
